Find every visible UI element in the screenshot: buttons, icons, menu items, tabs, links, text input fields, checkboxes, radio buttons, dropdowns, sliders, list or table items, labels, headings, text blocks and images. Report each distinct element once, with a tight box around that element only.

The four images are overlapping crops of ONE screenshot at native resolution: crop 1 is the top-left part, crop 2 the top-right, crop 3 the bottom-left and crop 4 the bottom-right. Neighbouring crops overlap by a narrow strip. The crops show each proposed change k: red boxes labelled k- are the draft elements the change removes or corrects; green boxes labelled k+ are the elements it would add. For EACH proposed change decide: "apply" if the change is visually justified and makes the list more faithful to the screenshot; "keep" to retain the draft as it is; "uncertain" if the image does not let you decide. Check whether an added element really exists and is not already in the draft, whether a deleted element really is not a UI element or is a duplicate, and whether a corrected box fits the element better. Do not propose new changes.

Output contract: one JSON object {"decisions": [{"change": 1, "decision": "apply"}, ...]} with one entry per change. No prose, no code fence.
